title: Evaluating Alcohol Use in Alcoholic Liver Disease
brief_summary: This prospective, analytic observational study will investigate alcohol recidivism in patients with alcoholic liver disease. All adult subjects presenting with alcoholic liver disease are considered for inclusion. Subjects able to give consent are included.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* alcoholic liver disease able to consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* without alcoholic liver disease unable to consent
